name: Northstar
summary: A European humanoid from the startup Rémi Cadene founded after working on Tesla's Optimus and Autopilot, targeting 40 kg — far lighter than most full-size rivals. The look is deliberate: soft shell, exposed joints, a plain visor instead of a face, to read as a tool rather than a person. Its architecture is built around learning a task from one human demonstration.
notable: Founded by a former Tesla Optimus research scientist
